note: Election of the ten Larne Borough councillors, two for each of the five wards, polled Wednesday 17 May 1961 in Gardenmore Ward only (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1961, p. 10). Central was uncontested after W. S. McIlroy withdrew; Inver and Townparks had two nominations each; Curran had one, the other seat becoming a casual vacancy filled at a later election (Larne Times, 4, 11 and 25 May 1961). No party labels are printed for the unopposed members. The unsuccessful Labour candidate, Mr. A. Ringland, is named without his vote. The other wards were uncontested and are not itemised. Estimated poll 60 per cent.
